sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选访谈，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I don't think my kids have read the piece yet, but they were really excited to be fact-checked by the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我想我的孩子们还没读过这篇文章，但他们对能被《纽约时报》杂志核实事实感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: They thought that was the coolest thing ever.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这是有史以来最酷的事情。

sentences.en: My favorite moment of fact-checking was I wrote a line in there about how my daughter sometimes gets in fights with me and then apologizes.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的事实核查时刻是，我在文中写了一句关于我女儿有时会跟我吵架然后又道歉的话。

sentences.en: So the fact-checker was like, do you get in fights with your dad and apologize?
sentences.zh: 于是事实核查员问：你会跟你爸爸吵架然后道歉吗？

sentences.en: And my daughter said, I apologize for how I said it.
sentences.zh: 我女儿说：我为我说话的方式道歉。

sentences.en: I don't apologize for what I said because I know that what I said is right.
sentences.zh: 我不为我说过的话道歉，因为我知道我说的是对的。

sentences.en: And just to see that exchange happened in an email.
sentences.zh: 看到这段交流发生在电子邮件里，

sentences.en: I really loved that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: Hey, my name is Carvel Wallace, and I'm a contributing writer to the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我叫卡维尔·华莱士，是《纽约时报》杂志的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be reading my essay called Facing the Wind,
sentences.zh: 我将朗读我的文章《直面风暴》，

sentences.en: Raising Black Teenagers Amid Pandemic and ProteSt. You know, I was a parenting advice columnist for years before I wrote this piece.
sentences.zh: 在疫情与抗议中抚养黑人青少年。你知道，在写这篇文章之前，我做了多年的育儿建议专栏作家。

sentences.en: And what I see both in my own life and in all the parents that I heard from is that parenting is messy and it's confusing.
sentences.zh: 无论是在我自己的生活中，还是在我听到的所有父母的反馈中，我看到的都是：育儿是一团糟，而且令人困惑。

sentences.en: And your kids behave like monsters and you behave like a monster.
sentences.zh: 你的孩子表现得像个小怪物，而你也表现得像个大怪物。

sentences.en: That's all part of it.
sentences.zh: 这都是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And our job as parents is to show up honestly,
sentences.zh: 作为父母，我们的工作是诚实地、

sentences.en: continually, and to be present with our kids, however that looks.
sentences.zh: 持续地出现，并陪伴在孩子身边，无论那看起来是什么样子。

sentences.en: I wrote this piece a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我几周前写了这篇文章。

sentences.en: I started it.
sentences.zh: 我开始了写作。

sentences.en: And at that point, we were talking a lot about the killing of George Floyd and Ahmaud Arbery.
sentences.zh: 那时，我们正在热议乔治·弗洛伊德和阿莫德·阿贝里的遇害事件。

sentences.en: And when I look at this piece being published this week, a week in which many of us are reacting very deeply to the murder of the activist in Florida, Toyin Salau.
sentences.zh: 当我看到这篇文章在本周发表时——这一周，我们许多人对佛罗里达州活动家托因·萨劳的谋杀案反应极其强烈。

sentences.en: This one hits me so deeply for so many reasons.
sentences.zh: 这件事出于许多原因深深触动了我。

sentences.en: And part of it was because she was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分原因是她还是个青少年。

sentences.en: She was the same generation as my children.
sentences.zh: 她和我孩子是同一代人。

sentences.en: And I think about the ways in which when men are killed, everyone jumps into the street and hashtags immediately.
sentences.zh: 我想到当男性被杀害时，每个人都会立刻走上街头并使用标签。

sentences.en: And I want myself and my son and my daughter to know that that's not enough.
sentences.zh: 我希望我和我的儿子、女儿都知道，这还不够。

sentences.en: That what women and trans women and trans people face is many orders of magnitude beyond what we've been talking about so far.
sentences.zh: 女性、跨性别女性和跨性别群体所面临的困境，远比我们目前讨论的要严重得多。

sentences.en: And it's almost like you can't even write fast enough to keep up with this.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像你写得再快也赶不上事态的发展。

sentences.en: But I guess that's where I want our conversation to be.
sentences.zh: 但我想，这就是我希望我们对话所处的位置。

sentences.en: And that's where I want this to go as we move forward from this.
sentences.zh: 这也是我希望我们在未来继续探讨的方向。

sentences.en: So here is the essay, and I hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 那么，这就是这篇文章，希望您喜欢。

sentences.en: Before I saw them silhouetted by the fog of tear gas and the light of police helicopters,
sentences.zh: 在我看到他们被催泪瓦斯的迷雾和警用直升机的灯光映出剪影之前，

sentences.en: back when the crisis we were in meant that our world was uncomfortably quiet rather than uncomfortably loud, my teenagers and I were in need of things to do.
sentences.zh: 回到我们所处的危机意味着世界变得令人不安地安静，而不是令人不安地喧闹的时候，我和我的孩子们需要找点事做。

sentences.en: The options were limited.
sentences.zh: 选择很有限。

sentences.en: There was a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 当时正值疫情。

sentences.en: I could not take them to the mall or drop them off at a friend's house from which they would go to a
sentences.zh: 我不能带他们去商场，也不能把他们送到朋友家，让他们去

sentences.en: movie and wander around downtown having all kinds of experiences I would never know about unless one of them went horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 看电影，在市中心闲逛，经历各种我永远不会知道的事情，除非其中一件出了大乱子。

sentences.en: I could not take them to a museum and listen to them complain about how boring everything was, right up until they became obsessed with an exhibit they couldn't stop talking
sentences.zh: 我不能带他们去博物馆，听他们抱怨一切有多无聊，直到他们沉迷于某个展览，在昂贵的咖啡馆里

sentences.en: about in the overpriced cafe.
sentences.zh: 谈论个不停。

sentences.en: The world was closed to us.
sentences.zh: 世界对我们关闭了。

sentences.en: We only had the living room, the inside of a car, and a nebulous place known as outside.
sentences.zh: 我们只有客厅、车内，以及一个被称为“外面”的模糊空间。

sentences.en: Their whole lives, I have been the kind of parent who has dragged them through a series of adventures I hoped would split the difference between enriching and inexpensive.
sentences.zh: 在他们的一生中，我一直是一个带着他们进行一系列冒险的父亲，我希望这些冒险能在丰富多彩和经济实惠之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: My own father was a master of this.
sentences.zh: 我父亲就是这方面的高手。

sentences.en: I remember him taking me and my brother to watch planes take off from Washington National Airport, or strapping us into the front seat
sentences.zh: 我记得他带我和弟弟去华盛顿国家机场看飞机起飞，或者把我们绑在

sentences.en: of his cab so we could eavesdrop on his conversations with fares, from nuns to prostitutes to congresspeople.
sentences.zh: 他的出租车前座，让我们偷听他与乘客的谈话，从修女到妓女再到国会议员。

sentences.en: When my kids were little, and I was really broke, I tried to live by this same ethos.
sentences.zh: 当我的孩子们还小，而我真的很穷时，我试图遵循同样的理念。

sentences.en: A favorite adventure was to pick a random bus line here in Oakland and ride all the way to the end and
sentences.zh: 最喜欢的冒险是随机选择奥克兰的一条公交线路，坐到终点站再

sentences.en: back while the kids clambered on their knees in the plastic seats, watching the boulevards pass.
sentences.zh: 坐回来，孩子们在塑料座椅上爬来爬去，看着大道从窗外掠过。

sentences.en: I was trying to show them that there was enough beauty right in front of us, in the neighborhood, on the bus, at the library, to sustain us.
sentences.zh: 我试图向他们展示，在我们面前，在社区里，在公交车上，在图书馆里，有足够的美好来支撑我们。

sentences.en: There was beauty in the trees and the graffiti, the taco stands, and the people.
sentences.zh: 树木、涂鸦、塔可摊位和人们身上都有美。

sentences.en: We belonged to a world.
sentences.zh: 我们属于这个世界。

sentences.en: Our neighborhood was one that none of their Disney movies or Nickelodeon shows ever told them was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区是他们那些迪士尼电影或尼克儿童频道节目从未告诉过他们是美丽的地方。

sentences.en: I wanted to deprogram them, help them see that beauty was feral and wild, democratic and free, that it belonged to us, wherever and however and whoever we were.
sentences.zh: 我想为他们“反洗脑”，帮助他们看到美是野性的、狂野的、民主的和自由的，它属于我们，无论我们在哪里，无论我们是谁。

sentences.en: With the world closed, we had to search further.
sentences.zh: 随着世界关闭，我们不得不进一步探索。

sentences.en: I piled them into the car to go for drives.
sentences.zh: 我把他们塞进车里去兜风。

sentences.en: Often, I would have no idea where we were going until we were halfway there.
sentences.zh: 通常，直到半路上我才知道我们要去哪里。

sentences.en: A teacher in my college theater program, a director, once told me that when she was struggling in a rehearsal, she would sit in the last row of the theater and announce,
sentences.zh: 我大学戏剧课的一位老师，一位导演，曾经告诉我，当她在排练中遇到困难时，她会坐在剧院的最后一排，宣布：

sentences.en: I have an idea.
sentences.zh: 我有个主意。

sentences.en: She would then begin a long, slow walk toward the stage, and by the time she got there, she'd better have had an idea.
sentences.zh: 然后她会开始缓慢地走向舞台，等她走到那里时，她最好已经想出了主意。

sentences.en: It wasn't until I had kids that I understood this.
sentences.zh: 直到有了孩子，我才明白这一点。

sentences.en: We have visited beaches and forests, brackish inlets where seals bob and cranes perch.
sentences.zh: 我们参观过海滩和森林，参观过海豹嬉戏、鹤鸟栖息的微咸水湾。

sentences.en: We have driven to the campuses of colleges my daughter wants to attend to find halls emptied and coyotes roaming free through parking lots.
sentences.zh: 我们开车去过我女儿想上的大学校园，发现大厅空无一人，土狼在停车场自由漫步。

sentences.en: We have driven to the edge of the land in overwhelmingly white Marin County, where a parks official told us we had to go back to Oakland because they didn't want our germs there.
sentences.zh: 我们开车去过马林县那片白人聚居区的边缘，那里的一名公园官员告诉我们必须回奥克兰，因为他们不希望我们把病菌带到那里。

sentences.en: Because we are Californians, most of our important conversations happen in a car.
sentences.zh: 因为我们是加州人，我们大多数重要的对话都发生在车里。

sentences.en: Maybe we don't know how to talk meaningfully without the crutch of parallel gazes, a shared view on the world passing outside.
sentences.zh: 也许我们不知道如何在没有“并排凝视”这种拐杖的情况下进行有意义的交谈，即共享窗外掠过的世界。

sentences.en: I used to think we were all seeing the same thing on those rides, but my son once showed me a video he had shot from the back seat,
sentences.zh: 我曾经以为我们在那些旅途中看到的是同样的东西，但有一次我儿子给我看了他从后座拍的视频，

sentences.en: and I was startled to see myself in the rearview mirror.
sentences.zh: 我惊讶地在后视镜里看到了自己。

sentences.en: I looked so severe, so lost in dark thought, even as we were, in my mind, enjoying a chill Sunday drive through the empty city.
sentences.zh: 我看起来那么严肃，那么沉浸在阴暗的思绪中，尽管在我看来，我们正在空荡荡的城市里享受着轻松的周日兜风。

sentences.en: I realized in that moment that I had almost no idea what my son saw when he looked at the world.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我意识到，我几乎不知道儿子眼中的世界是什么样的。

sentences.en: My children were 13 and 11 at the time of the 2016 election, and it was in the car the morning after that they asked me what had happened.
sentences.zh: 2016年大选时，我的孩子们分别是13岁和11岁，第二天早上在车里，他们问我发生了什么。

sentences.en: I didn't know exactly what to tell them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么告诉他们。

sentences.en: I have an unfortunate need to explain everything as completely as possible, to offer them the grandest view.
sentences.zh: 我有一种不幸的冲动，想尽可能完整地解释一切，给他们提供最宏大的视角。

sentences.en: I worry it is too much for them, but they are stuck with the father they got.
sentences.zh: 我担心这对他们来说太多了，但他们只能接受他们拥有的这个父亲。

sentences.en: So I thought about it for a long time, as long as it took to get to the freeway and past the first two exits, the gas station,
sentences.zh: 所以我思考了很久，久到足以开上高速公路，经过前两个出口、加油站、

sentences.en: the temple, the curve where I once saw a car spin out late at night, barely missing me at 70 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 寺庙，以及我曾经看到一辆车在深夜打滑、以每小时70英里的速度险些撞到我的那个弯道。

sentences.en: That night, I kept driving, and another car seemed to stop to help, or at least I decided it did, as I continued into the darkness, my heart still in my throat.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我继续开车，另一辆车似乎停下来帮忙，或者至少我决定它是停下来了，我继续驶入黑暗，心还在嗓子眼提着。

sentences.en: Finally, I told my children that one of the most important questions you have to answer for yourself is this.
sentences.zh: 最后，我告诉孩子们，你必须为自己回答的最重要的问题之一是这个：

sentences.en: Do I believe in loving everyone, or do I only believe in loving myself and my people?
sentences.zh: 我是相信爱所有人，还是只相信爱我自己和我的人？

sentences.en: I told them that their mother and I had each decided at some point in our lives that we believed in trying to love everyone, but there were
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们，他们的母亲和我都在人生的某个时刻决定，我们相信尝试去爱所有人，但有

sentences.en: some people who simply did not believe in loving everyone, and that was just the way it was.
sentences.zh: 些人根本不相信爱所有人，事实就是这样。

sentences.en: I told them that their mother and I had made our choices, but we could not decide for them what kind of people they would be.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们，他们的母亲和我做出了我们的选择，但我们不能替他们决定他们会成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: They had to decide for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们必须自己决定。

sentences.en: They were quiet.
sentences.zh: 他们沉默了。

sentences.en: Maybe this was a pivotal moment in their young lives.
sentences.zh: 也许这是他们年轻生命中的一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: I wanted to think it was, but maybe they tuned out after 30 seconds, letting their thoughts wander to things more present and graspable, like what I had packed in their lunchboxes.
sentences.zh: 我想认为它是，但也许他们在30秒后就走神了，让思绪飘向更现实、更可触及的事情，比如我在午餐盒里给他们装了什么。

sentences.en: On one trip in late March, we ended up across the bay in San Francisco on the top of Bernal Hill, a windy, grassy rise near the geographic center of the city.
sentences.zh: 3月下旬的一次旅行中，我们最终来到了海湾对岸的旧金山，在伯纳尔高地的山顶上，那是城市地理中心附近一个多风的草地高地。

sentences.en: Under normal non-quarantine circumstances, this is a trip that could take 75 minutes one way, but we have not had normal circumstances for a while.
sentences.zh: 在正常的非隔离情况下，这趟行程单程可能需要75分钟，但我们已经有一段时间没有正常情况了。

sentences.en: It took 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 只用了15分钟。

sentences.en: On the way there, I took a detour to show them a building in Bayview where I used to work at a non-profit.
sentences.zh: 在去那里的路上，我绕道带他们看了我在湾景区工作过的一家非营利组织大楼。

sentences.en: This was before they were born, before their mother and I were married.
sentences.zh: 那是在他们出生之前，在我们结婚之前。

sentences.en: I had never shown them this part of my life before, but somehow it felt time.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未向他们展示过我生活的这一部分，但不知何故，我觉得是时候了。

sentences.en: The streets were empty.
sentences.zh: 街道空无一人。

sentences.en: The world would soon be theirs.
sentences.zh: 世界很快就会属于他们。

sentences.en: Perhaps it already was.
sentences.zh: 也许它已经是了。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't I tell them every single thing?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不把每一件事都告诉他们呢？

sentences.en: When I worked there, I helped run a youth gardening program.
sentences.zh: 我在那里工作时，曾协助运营一个青年园艺项目。

sentences.en: We managed several farms in the housing projects, grew vegetables, sold or donated them to residents, taught kids about nutrition and nature.
sentences.zh: 我们在保障性住房项目中管理着几个农场，种植蔬菜，出售或捐赠给居民，教孩子们关于营养和自然的知识。

sentences.en: They came to our program torn between what most would consider two worlds.
sentences.zh: 他们来到我们的项目时，在大多数人认为的两个世界之间挣扎。

sentences.en: On one hand, incarcerated parents, siblings lost to violence and addiction, and a world that treated them as throwaways.
sentences.zh: 一方面是入狱的父母、因暴力和毒瘾失去的兄弟姐妹，以及一个把他们视为废弃物的世界。

sentences.en: On the other hand, organic farming of strawberries.
sentences.zh: 另一方面是草莓的有机耕作。

sentences.en: I was in my early 20s and in over my head, as almost everyone who works with youth is, but I knew that I really liked the kids, even the difficult ones.
sentences.zh: 我当时20出头，力不从心，就像几乎所有与年轻人一起工作的人一样，但我知道我真的很喜欢这些孩子，即使是那些难管的孩子。

sentences.en: I liked their wit and brilliance, their hunger for something positive.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他们的机智和才华，他们对积极事物的渴望。

sentences.en: I liked their gallows humor about working in the fields like slaves, their consistent clowning of my white hippie co-workers.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他们关于像奴隶一样在田里干活的“绞刑架幽默”，喜欢他们一贯嘲弄我那些白人嬉皮士同事的样子。

sentences.en: Mostly, I liked the way they kept coming back, day after day, to share the simple, timeless miracle of seeing food grow from the ground.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我喜欢他们日复一日地回来，分享那种看着食物从地里长出来的简单而永恒的奇迹。

sentences.en: The organization eventually folded after the city, amid allegations of corruption and misuse of funds, barred it from receiving municipal contracts.
sentences.zh: 该组织最终在城市因腐败和滥用资金的指控禁止其获得市政合同后倒闭了。

sentences.en: Its executive director went on to a high-profile job with the city, but on the first day of quarantine, a former co-worker sent me an article
sentences.zh: 其执行董事后来在市政府谋得了一份高职，但在隔离的第一天，一位前同事给我发了一篇文章，

sentences.en: about how he was now facing federal charges in a bribery scheme.
sentences.zh: 关于他现在因贿赂计划面临联邦指控。

sentences.en: He and I never talked often, but he would occasionally summon me to his office and take me into his confidence, maybe because I was young and black and seemingly impressionable.
sentences.zh: 我和他并不常交谈，但他偶尔会把我叫到办公室，向我吐露心声，也许是因为我年轻、黑人，而且看起来很容易受影响。

sentences.en: Once he asked, who else is doing for our people what we're doing?
sentences.zh: 有一次他问：还有谁在为我们的人民做我们正在做的事？

sentences.en: Let someone else step up if they don't like how I do business.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不喜欢我的经营方式，就让别人来接手吧。

sentences.en: Some 20 years later, I still don't know what I think about that.
sentences.zh: 大约20年后，我仍然不知道自己对此作何感想。

sentences.en: I know he was wildly problematic.
sentences.zh: 我知道他有严重的问题。

sentences.en: I also know that one of our farms, a beautiful multi-acre farm, still stands today in a neighborhood where for decades the only place to buy food was the liquor store.
sentences.zh: 我也知道，我们的一个农场，一个美丽的数英亩农场，至今仍矗立在一个几十年来唯一能买到食物的地方就是酒类商店的社区里。

sentences.en: We arrived at Bernal Hill about 20 minutes before sunset and began climbing the dirt path on the south side.
sentences.zh: 我们在日落前约20分钟到达伯纳尔高地，开始攀登南侧的土路。

sentences.en: I lingered far behind the kids so I could take videos of them silhouetted against a vast azure sky, grass undulating at their feet, and because I simply
sentences.zh: 我远远地落在孩子们后面，这样我就可以拍摄他们映衬在广阔蔚蓝天空下的剪影，草地在他们脚下起伏，而且因为我实在

sentences.en: could not walk the hill as fast as they could.
sentences.zh: 无法像他们那样快地走上山坡。

sentences.en: My knees hurt, my breath felt thin.
sentences.zh: 我的膝盖疼，呼吸感到急促。

sentences.en: Stuck in the house, the kids vacillated between intense goofiness, door-slamming arguments, and a zombie-like trance as they methodically
sentences.zh: 困在家里，孩子们在极度的傻气、摔门而出的争吵，以及一种僵尸般的恍惚状态之间摇摆不定，他们机械地

sentences.en: worked through every show, YouTube video, and TikTok ever made.
sentences.zh: 刷完了所有节目、YouTube视频和TikTok。

sentences.en: But here, outside, despite the fact that they are 14 and 17, and one of them is taller than me by at least two inches, they ran together as if they
sentences.zh: 但在这里，在外面，尽管他们已经14岁和17岁了，其中一个比我高出至少两英寸，他们还是像小时候一样一起奔跑，

sentences.en: were still little, as if they were briefly enjoying the childhood everyone told us they should have, their laughter echoing off the hills.
sentences.zh: 仿佛他们短暂地享受着每个人都告诉我们他们应该拥有的童年，他们的笑声在山间回荡。

sentences.en: We reached the top, where the wind is ferocious.
sentences.zh: 我们到达了山顶，那里的风非常猛烈。

sentences.en: My daughter, who brought a blanket, rushed to the windiest spot she could find, called out for her older brother's attention, faced the golden sun, and lifted the blanket over her
sentences.zh: 我女儿带了一条毯子，冲向她能找到的最风大的地方，大声呼唤她哥哥的注意，面对金色的太阳，把毯子像旗帜一样举过

sentences.en: head like a flag.
sentences.zh: 头顶。

sentences.en: The sudden beauty of the moment stung me, and I could think of nothing to do but take a video.
sentences.zh: 那一刻突如其来的美感刺痛了我，我除了录像什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Here is a 14-year-old girl, standing atop a hill in the middle of a global pandemic, at a moment in which I am thinking more than usual about death.
sentences.zh: 这是一个14岁的女孩，站在全球疫情期间的一座山顶上，在这个我比平时更多地思考死亡的时刻。

sentences.en: My personal death, our collective death, the death of the planet.
sentences.zh: 我个人的死亡，我们集体的死亡，地球的死亡。

sentences.en: She faces the wind with all of her bodily might, exalting in the confrontation.
sentences.zh: 她用尽全身力气面对风，在对抗中欢呼。

sentences.en: The magic hour light is a cinematic gold on her face.
sentences.zh: 魔幻时刻的灯光在她脸上投下电影般的金色。

sentences.en: The wind whips her hair.
sentences.zh: 风吹乱了她的头发。

sentences.en: Her hoodie and black track pants cover her like modern armor.
sentences.zh: 她的连帽衫和黑色运动裤像现代盔甲一样覆盖着她。

sentences.en: I was reminded of soldiers planting the flag in
sentences.zh: 我想起了士兵们在

sentences.en: Iwo Jima.
sentences.zh: 硫磺岛插旗的情景。

sentences.en: Of the viral photo of a shirtless Palestinian protester holding a flag in a slingshot.
sentences.zh: 想起了那张病毒式传播的照片：一名赤裸上身的巴勒斯坦抗议者用弹弓拿着一面旗帜。

sentences.en: Of Ujene Delacroix's liberty leading the people.
sentences.zh: 想起了欧仁·德拉克罗瓦的《自由引导人民》。

sentences.en: I was reminded of the intense, unflagging, unselfconscious strength of my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我想起了我女儿那种强烈、不懈、毫不自知的力量。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，您可以在应用内免费畅读第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 花一个月时间越过付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能读到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载时报应用，获取30天的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: My teenagers have, on the whole, taken the pandemic much better than their parents have.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我的孩子们应对疫情的态度比他们的父母好得多。

sentences.en: My daughter especially found our daily briefings of coronavirus developments tedious.
sentences.zh: 尤其是我的女儿，她觉得我们每天关于新冠疫情进展的简报非常乏味。

sentences.en: She suffers from anxiety, and in the beginning we understood her impatience as a healthy expression of her stress.
sentences.zh: 她患有焦虑症，起初我们认为她的不耐烦是压力的一种健康宣泄。

sentences.en: But lately I've begun to wonder if it's not something altogether simpler.
sentences.zh: 但最近我开始怀疑，事情可能远没有那么简单。

sentences.en: She's just bored of hearing the adults in her life bemoan the world we clearly created.
sentences.zh: 她只是厌倦了听生活中的大人们抱怨我们亲手创造的这个世界。

sentences.en: Her generation has known nothing but chaos and impending doom.
sentences.zh: 她这一代人除了混乱和迫在眉睫的灾难，什么都没见过。

sentences.en: She was in third grade the first time our minivan was diverted from the road on the way home from school by a phalanx of officers in riot gear.
sentences.zh: 她上三年级时，我们第一次在放学回家的路上，被一群全副武装的防暴警察拦下，不得不绕道而行。

sentences.en: She was six the first time she asked me about climate change.
sentences.zh: 她六岁时第一次问我关于气候变化的问题。

sentences.en: Her white male sixth grade teacher said the N-word with a hard R.
sentences.zh: 她六年级的白人男老师用了带有强烈种族歧视色彩的词汇。

sentences.en: Her seventh grade science teacher gave the class the New Yorker article about the West Coast's inevitable city-destroying earthquake.
sentences.zh: 她七年级的科学老师给全班发了《纽约客》上关于西海岸不可避免的毁灭性地震的文章。

sentences.en: She was 12 when an 18-year-old Black woman was murdered in what many feared was a racially motivated attack on the same BART platform where she catches the train to school.
sentences.zh: 她12岁那年，一名18岁的黑人女性在BART车站站台上被谋杀，许多人担心这是一起种族动机的袭击，而她平时就是在那同一个站台乘车上学。

sentences.en: She has lived through school shooting drills, neo-Nazi rallies in the park where she used to play,
sentences.zh: 她经历过校园枪击演习，经历过她曾经玩耍的公园里举行的各种新纳粹集会，

sentences.en: police murders, car break-ins, sexual predators lingering outside her schoolyard, and weeks of wildfires that turn the sky orange and make it impossible to breathe outdoors.
sentences.zh: 经历过警察杀人、汽车被砸、学校操场外徘徊的性掠夺者，还有让天空变橙、让人在户外无法呼吸的持续数周的野火。

sentences.en: A global pandemic that shuts down the world was not news to her.
sentences.zh: 一场让世界停摆的全球大流行病对她来说并不算新闻。

sentences.en: It was the opposite of news.
sentences.zh: 这恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It was something as old as her life.
sentences.zh: 这就像她的人生一样，早已司空见惯。

sentences.en: She found a perch on the top of the hill to sit in the sun, fashioning the blanket around her legs to protect herself from the wind.
sentences.zh: 她在山顶找了个位置坐下晒太阳，把毯子裹在腿上挡风。

sentences.en: Sometimes my daughter resents being dragged along on hikes.
sentences.zh: 有时女儿很反感被我们拉去徒步。

sentences.en: Her resistance is mostly good-spirited, a quick eye roll, but every once in a while she hits within herself an obstinance that borders on the self-destructive.
sentences.zh: 她的抵触情绪大多是善意的，顶多翻个白眼，但偶尔她会陷入一种近乎自毁的固执之中。

sentences.en: She tells me she'd rather sit alone in a parking lot than walk with us along a trail, or that she's going to call her mother who
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她宁愿独自坐在停车场，也不愿和我们一起走小径，或者说她要打电话让她母亲来接她，

sentences.en: is an hour away to pick her up because she doesn't want to wait for 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 因为她母亲在一小时路程外，而她不想等上30分钟。

sentences.en: In these moments, she has a kind of scorched-earth policy on airing her grievances.
sentences.zh: 在这些时刻，她在发泄不满时有一种“焦土政策”般的决绝。

sentences.en: She will, in the knife-like and breakneck style of a 14-year-old, tell me I always have to be right, tell her mother she's
sentences.zh: 她会用14岁孩子那种尖锐而迅猛的方式，说我总是自以为是，说她母亲

sentences.en: manipulative and passive-aggressive, tell all of us she doesn't care about our feelings.
sentences.zh: 操纵人心、消极抵抗，告诉我们所有人她根本不在乎我们的感受。

sentences.en: It hurts in a way that little else does.
sentences.zh: 这种伤害是其他任何事情都无法比拟的。

sentences.en: Later, she will apologize.
sentences.zh: 过一会儿，她会道歉。

sentences.en: Later, we can have an honest, gentle talk about these feelings.
sentences.zh: 之后，我们可以就这些感受进行一次诚恳、温和的交谈。

sentences.en: Her wisdom in those talks leaves me speechless, just as her sudden nihilism sometimes terrifies me and leaves me shattered.
sentences.zh: 她在交谈中展现出的智慧让我哑口无言，就像她偶尔表现出的那种突如其来的虚无主义让我感到恐惧和心碎一样。

sentences.en: My son and I venture downhill, watching the grasses blow in waves like green velvet.
sentences.zh: 我和儿子向山下走去，看着草丛像绿色的天鹅绒一样随风起伏。

sentences.en: He talked to me about his relationship.
sentences.zh: 他跟我聊起了他的感情生活。

sentences.en: He had questions about what to do with another person's feelings.
sentences.zh: 他问我该如何处理别人的感受。

sentences.en: I started by trying to tell him what I know, which I quickly realized was not much.
sentences.zh: 我试着告诉他我所知道的，但我很快意识到我其实所知甚少。

sentences.en: So I ended up telling him what I don't know, what I struggle with, how much time I've
sentences.zh: 所以我最后告诉了他我不知道的事情，我所挣扎的事情，以及我花了多少时间

sentences.en: spent trying to control what others think of me, or treating every opportunity and intimacy as though it were life or death.
sentences.zh: 试图控制别人对我的看法，或者把每一次机会和亲密关系都看得生死攸关。

sentences.en: I told him how I did not know how to love myself, so I looked to other people to love me, and how rarely that worked.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我曾经不知道如何爱自己，所以我指望别人来爱我，而这种做法很少奏效。

sentences.en: He likes to argue with me, and I guess I like to argue with him because we do it all the time, about politics, movies, school, money, work.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢和我争论，我想我也喜欢和他争论，因为我们总是这样，讨论政治、电影、学校、金钱、工作。

sentences.en: He has admitted that he will often go to his friends and argue the very same position he resisted so fiercely when I was arguing it.
sentences.zh: 他承认，他经常会去和朋友争论同一个观点，而当我在争论时，他却激烈地抵触这个观点。

sentences.en: It's how I learn, he once told me.
sentences.zh: “这就是我的学习方式，”他曾经告诉我。

sentences.en: Can you learn by listening, I replied, because his sister is right.
sentences.zh: “你能通过倾听来学习吗？”我反驳道，因为他姐姐说得对。

sentences.en: I do always need the last word.
sentences.zh: 我确实总是需要最后发言权。

sentences.en: On our way back up the hill, a red-tailed hawk flew past his head, seemingly within inches.
sentences.zh: 在我们回山顶的路上，一只红尾鵟从他头顶飞过，距离似乎只有几英寸。

sentences.en: Silently it swooped toward the top of the hill and began bobbing in the wind.
sentences.zh: 它悄无声息地俯冲向山顶，开始在风中上下起伏。

sentences.en: An old woman walking the trail with her cane beside her looked at both of us and then at the bird.
sentences.zh: 一位拄着拐杖走在小径上的老妇人看了看我们，又看了看那只鸟。

sentences.en: It's an auspicious sign, she told us.
sentences.zh: “这是个吉兆，”她告诉我们。

sentences.en: At the top of the hill, hikers began to gather and watch.
sentences.zh: 在山顶，徒步者们开始聚集观看。

sentences.en: Careful to keep their distance from one another.
sentences.zh: 大家都小心翼翼地保持着距离。

sentences.en: No one talked.
sentences.zh: 没有人说话。

sentences.en: The kids watched with me for a little while, but soon they complained of cold and boredom.
sentences.zh: 孩子们和我一起看了一会儿，但很快就抱怨又冷又无聊。

sentences.en: I gave my daughter the keys, and they trudged back toward the car.
sentences.zh: 我把钥匙给了女儿，他们拖着步子往车那边走去。

sentences.en: Soon, I was alone.
sentences.zh: 很快，我独自一人留在了那里。

sentences.en: I could feel the wind whipping through me as though I were made of nothing permanent.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到风穿过我的身体，仿佛我并非永恒的存在。

sentences.en: Something happened to me in that moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我身上发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: Something to do with the cold, the wind chipping holes in my body.
sentences.zh: 与寒冷有关，与风在我的身体上凿出空洞有关。

sentences.en: Something about the hawk just being a hawk and not a person and reminding me that I don't have to be a person forever.
sentences.zh: 与那只鵟仅仅是一只鵟而不是一个人有关，它提醒我，我不必永远做一个“人”。

sentences.en: Something about experiencing this beautiful moment with my kids and then my kids going away because it was time for them to go and be warm on their phones and
sentences.zh: 与和孩子们一起经历这个美好的时刻有关，然后孩子们离开了，因为他们该去暖和的地方玩手机了，

sentences.en: maybe figure out what kind of burritos they want me to get them on the way home.
sentences.zh: 也许还在琢磨回家路上想让我给他们买什么样的墨西哥卷饼。

sentences.en: I remember when my son was being born and the midwife described labor.
sentences.zh: 我记得儿子出生时，助产士描述分娩的情景。

sentences.en: On one side, there are all the women who have not given birth.
sentences.zh: 一边是所有还没生过孩子的女性。

sentences.en: And on the other, there are all the mothers welcoming you with love and open arMs.
sentences.zh: 另一边是所有用爱和怀抱欢迎你的母亲们。

sentences.en: And in the middle is a long, dark path that you and only you must walk alone.
sentences.zh: 而中间是一条漫长、黑暗的道路，你必须独自走过。

sentences.en: Something about my getting older, a thing I definitely didn't think I was going to be doing.
sentences.zh: 与我变老有关，这是一件我绝对没想过自己会经历的事情。

sentences.en: Something about having once held my dying mother in my arms and knowing that I, too, will one day be one of the dying, maybe even soon.
sentences.zh: 与我曾经抱着垂死的母亲，知道自己终有一天也会成为垂死者之一有关，也许这一天很快就会到来。

sentences.en: Something about realizing that no matter how much I try to prepare my children for the fact that their father is only a man, a man who will one day grow old and weak and
sentences.zh: 与意识到无论我多么努力地让孩子们明白他们的父亲只是个普通人，一个终有一天会变老、变虚弱并

sentences.en: die, they won't fully realize what that means until it's too late.
sentences.zh: 死去的人，但在为时已晚之前，他们都不会真正理解这意味着什么。

sentences.en: Something about all of this reminds me that I am, in the end, walking this alone.
sentences.zh: 与这一切有关的事情提醒我，归根结底，我是在独自前行。

sentences.en: Even though we do, on this Wednesday, go and get burritos together.
sentences.zh: 尽管在这个周三，我们确实一起去买了卷饼。

sentences.en: A few days later, my daughter is telling me that her mother doesn't care about her mental health.
sentences.zh: 几天后，女儿告诉我，她母亲根本不在乎她的心理健康。

sentences.en: She is crying, so I try to stifle my laughter.
sentences.zh: 她哭得很伤心，所以我努力忍住笑意。

sentences.en: I can think of no person on earth who cares more about anything than her mother cares about her.
sentences.zh: 我想不出世上还有谁比她母亲更关心她的一切。

sentences.en: A few days later, I criticize the way my son does or doesn't help around the house.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我批评了儿子在家务事上的表现。

sentences.en: He blows up at me.
sentences.zh: 他对我大发雷霆。

sentences.en: He tells me he's tired of my parenting.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他厌倦了我的管教。

sentences.en: He tells me that he knows I don't approve of him and that he doesn't want to hear what I think.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他知道我不认可他，他不想听我的想法。

sentences.en: It occurs to me that my children are sometimes irretrievably selfish.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到，我的孩子们有时是不可救药地自私。

sentences.en: How much of that is their age, their development, their generation?
sentences.zh: 这其中有多少是源于他们的年龄、成长阶段和他们那一代人？

sentences.en: How much of it is me?
sentences.zh: 又有多少是我的原因？

sentences.en: The next day, my son sits me down to talk through his theories about race and media.
sentences.zh: 第二天，儿子坐下来和我讨论他关于种族和媒体的理论。

sentences.en: A couple days later, he tells me again that he wants nothing to do with me.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他又一次告诉我他不想和我扯上任何关系。

sentences.en: At one point, he watches the video of Ahmaud Arbery's killing.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他看了阿莫德·阿贝里的遇害视频。

sentences.en: The Black jogger was running in a quiet Georgia neighborhood when three men in pickup trucks
sentences.zh: 那位黑人慢跑者当时正在佐治亚州一个安静的社区跑步，三名开着皮卡的男子

sentences.en: chased him down, including a retired law enforcement officer and his adult son, who shot him multiple times, claiming they believed he was a burglar.
sentences.zh: 追赶他，其中包括一名退休的执法人员和他的成年儿子，他们开了多枪将他射杀，声称他们以为他是窃贼。

sentences.en: For an hour, I listened to my own child work through the horrifyingly mundane process a young Black man goes through when he watches another young Black man be killed.
sentences.zh: 我花了一个小时，听着我自己的孩子经历那种令人毛骨悚然的、平庸的过程——当一个年轻黑人看着另一个年轻黑人被杀时所经历的过程。

sentences.en: This can't be.
sentences.zh: “这不可能。”

sentences.en: It makes no sense.
sentences.zh: “这毫无道理。”

sentences.en: Why would they do that?
sentences.zh: “他们为什么要那样做？”

sentences.en: They're going to prison, right?
sentences.zh: “他们会坐牢的，对吧？”

sentences.en: After a while, my daughter joins.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，女儿也加入了。

sentences.en: Dad, have you seen this video?
sentences.zh: “爸爸，你看过这个视频吗？”

sentences.en: I don't watch these videos, I tell them.
sentences.zh: “我不看这些视频，”我告诉他们。

sentences.en: And then I pause before I say, I've been seeing them since I was your age.
sentences.zh: 然后我停顿了一下，说道：“我从你们这个年纪起就开始看这些了。”

sentences.en: I don't look at them anymore.
sentences.zh: “我不再看它们了。”

sentences.en: I can think of nothing else to do but tell them the truth.
sentences.zh: 除了告诉他们真相，我想不出还能做什么。

sentences.en: I've been seeing these videos my whole life, I say.
sentences.zh: “我这辈子都在看这些视频，”我说。

sentences.en: You want to know what my trauma is?
sentences.zh: “你们想知道我的创伤是什么吗？”

sentences.en: It's this.
sentences.zh: “就是这个。”

sentences.en: It is a sentence that feels reckless, sharp in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 这句话说出口时，我觉得有些鲁莽，甚至有些刺耳。

sentences.en: I don't know why I say it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么会说出来。

sentences.en: Maybe just because it's true.
sentences.zh: 也许只是因为它确实是真的。

sentences.en: I don't know if they understand.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否理解。

sentences.en: I don't know if I do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我自己是否理解。

sentences.en: I only know that it is incredibly sad to admit to your children that you've been seeing videos of Black men being killed since you were their age and you haven't
sentences.zh: 我只知道，向自己的孩子承认，你从他们这个年纪起就一直在看黑人被杀的视频，却

sentences.en: been able to stop it.
sentences.zh: 无力阻止，这是一件极其悲哀的事情。

sentences.en: I only know that I have spent a long time avoiding loving myself so that if I am killed, it won't be that great a loss.
sentences.zh: 我只知道，我花了很长时间去避免爱自己，这样如果我被杀，那也不会是什么巨大的损失。

sentences.en: I only know that it is hard to show them how to love everyone if you're not even sure how to love yourself.
sentences.zh: 我只知道，如果你连自己都不知道如何去爱，就很难教他们如何去爱每一个人。

sentences.en: I know that it is time to tell them the truths I have been afraid to tell them until now.
sentences.zh: 我知道是时候告诉他们那些我一直不敢说出口的真相了。

sentences.en: They say nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没说。

sentences.en: The conversation doesn't end until we've handled some logistics.
sentences.zh: 谈话直到我们处理完一些琐事才结束。

sentences.en: I'm taking them to do laundry tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天我要带他们去洗衣服。

sentences.en: What's our plan for Mother's
sentences.zh: 我们母亲节的计划是什么？

sentences.en: Day?
sentences.zh: “母亲节”？

sentences.en: Can I help my daughter with her math homework?
sentences.zh: 我可以帮女儿做数学作业吗？

sentences.en: Of course I can.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: They tell me they love me.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我他们爱我。

sentences.en: To be asked for life advice in one moment and to be told you are a bad parent and have ruined your child's life the next, this is what parenting is.
sentences.zh: 上一秒被征求人生建议，下一秒就被告知你是个糟糕的父母，毁了孩子的一生，这就是为人父母的常态。

sentences.en: It is a thing you do alone because your kids cannot and must not understand all of what you are living.
sentences.zh: 这是一件你必须独自完成的事，因为你的孩子不能也不应该理解你所经历的一切。

sentences.en: It is terribly painful that my son thinks I have ruined his life.
sentences.zh: 儿子认为我毁了他的一生，这让我感到无比痛苦。

sentences.en: He's not entirely wrong.
sentences.zh: 他也不完全是错的。

sentences.en: I am a wildly imperfect parent.
sentences.zh: 我是一个极其不完美的父母。

sentences.en: I have lost my temper, neglected his emotional needs, taken his normal childish behavior as a personal attack.
sentences.zh: 我发过脾气，忽视过他的情感需求，把孩子正常的行为当成是对我个人的攻击。

sentences.en: I have made tremendous mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我犯过巨大的错误。

sentences.en: Perhaps the biggest mistake was bringing him into a world where we all have to wear masks, where riot squads assemble in front of our minivan, where the climate is on a collision
sentences.zh: 也许最大的错误就是把他带到了这样一个世界：我们都必须戴着口罩，防暴队在我们的车前集结，气候正处于与

sentences.en: course with the destruction of the human race, where encampments of houseless people grow larger
sentences.zh: 人类种族毁灭相撞的轨道上，无家可归者的营地每天都在变得越来越大、

sentences.en: and wilder every day, where he can watch himself be murdered over and over again just by clicking a link.
sentences.zh: 越来越混乱，他只要点击一个链接，就能一遍又一遍地看着自己被谋杀。

sentences.en: This is the world I let be created.
sentences.zh: 这就是我任由其形成的世界。

sentences.en: Under my watch.
sentences.zh: 在我眼皮底下。

sentences.en: They know this.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这一点。

sentences.en: They blame me for it.
sentences.zh: 他们因此责怪我。

sentences.en: They are right.
sentences.zh: 他们是对的。

sentences.en: It hurts my heart.
sentences.zh: 这让我心痛。

sentences.en: Also, would you like dinner?
sentences.zh: 另外，你们想吃晚饭吗？

sentences.en: What movie should we watch?
sentences.zh: 我们该看什么电影？

sentences.en: Tell me about your day.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你今天过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Parenting, like life, is heartbreak followed by reality, followed by love, followed by loneliness, followed by despair, followed by jokes, followed by exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 为人父母，就像生活本身，是心碎之后紧接着现实，接着是爱，接着是孤独，接着是绝望，接着是玩笑，接着是精疲力竭。

sentences.en: If this is what you are experiencing, you are doing it right.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在经历这些，说明你做得很对。

sentences.en: If you are returning over and over again to watch the simple miracle of growth, you are doing it right.
sentences.zh: 如果你一次又一次地回来观看成长的简单奇迹，说明你做得很对。

sentences.en: Less than three weeks later, both of them were at a protest in downtown Oakland after the killing of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 不到三周后，在乔治·弗洛伊德被杀后，他们俩都参加了奥克兰市中心的抗议活动。

sentences.en: They were too young to be there on that first night when we knew there would be tear gas and violence, but too old for their mother and
sentences.zh: 在那个我们知道会有催泪瓦斯和暴力的第一晚，他们去那里还太小，但对于他们的母亲和

sentences.en: me to stop them from walking a few short blocks to the center of it.
sentences.zh: 我来说，阻止他们走到几个街区外的中心地带又太大了。

sentences.en: Too old for me to tell them that when unarmed black people are killed, they shouldn't go into the streets.
sentences.zh: 大到我无法告诉他们，当手无寸铁的黑人被杀时，他们不应该走上街头。

sentences.en: So I made my own way down to run into them.
sentences.zh: 所以我自己赶过去，想去和他们汇合。

sentences.en: Nothing was coordinated yet.
sentences.zh: 当时还没有任何组织协调。

sentences.en: It would be a few days before students at our daughter's school would organize the city's biggest and best managed demonstration, some 15,000 people.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我们女儿学校的学生们组织了全市规模最大、组织得最好的示威活动，约有15000人参加。

sentences.en: Our city is no stranger to protests.
sentences.zh: 我们的城市对抗议活动并不陌生。

sentences.en: I have walked these same streets for climate marches, women's marches for justice in the wake of the murder of a teenager on a train platform,
sentences.zh: 我曾走过同样的街道参加气候游行、妇女正义游行，那是在一名青少年在站台上被谋杀之后，

sentences.en: the police shooting of an unarmed black man on a different train platform.
sentences.zh: 以及一名手无寸铁的黑人在另一个站台上被警察枪杀之后。

sentences.en: My son's school is only a few blocks away.
sentences.zh: 我儿子的学校离这里只有几个街区。

sentences.en: He has, I presume, ditched class here, shopped for shoes here, watched drug deals and fights here, gotten boba here, gotten sandwiches
sentences.zh: 我想他一定在这里逃过课，在这里买过鞋，在这里看过毒品交易和打架，在这里买过奶茶，买过三明治，

sentences.en: from the shop where the lady knows every student by name, sat on a bench after school here, just growing up minute by minute, experience by experience.
sentences.zh: 从那位能叫出每个学生名字的店主那里，放学后在这里坐过长椅，就这样一分钟一分钟、一次经历又一次经历地长大。

sentences.en: When I finally pushed through the crowd to find them and their friends, all masked, I felt for a moment that I was seeing strangers
sentences.zh: 当我终于挤过人群找到他们和他们的朋友时，看着他们都戴着口罩，那一刻我感觉自己看到的像是陌生人，

sentences.en: and not the kids I used to push around in a double stroller and feed baby carrots to.
sentences.zh: 而不是我曾经推着双人婴儿车、喂他们吃胡萝卜条的孩子们。

sentences.en: Soon, I found myself explaining how to stay safe, how tear gas works, how to tell what the police are
sentences.zh: 很快，我发现自己在向他们解释如何保持安全，催泪瓦斯是如何运作的，如何判断警察的

sentences.en: planning, which direction to go if the frontline pushes, how to avoid getting penned in on a block,
sentences.zh: 动向，如果前线推进该往哪个方向走，如何避免被困在街区里，

sentences.en: how to tell when it's time to retreat to where it's safer, how to tell who among the protesters to trust and who to be wary of.
sentences.zh: 如何判断什么时候该撤退到更安全的地方，如何分辨抗议者中哪些人值得信任，哪些人需要提防。

sentences.en: I had the feeling I often have with my teenagers, that everything is happening too fast, the world is closing in too quickly on them, that I have no way, no time,
sentences.zh: 我常在面对十几岁的孩子时有这种感觉：一切发生得太快了，世界向他们逼近得太快了，我没有办法，没有时间，

sentences.en: and no energy left to prepare them for all of it.
sentences.zh: 也没有精力去为他们准备好面对这一切。

sentences.en: I eventually persuaded both of them to leave with me, even though there was a part of them that wanted to stay, even though the chaos and darkness,
sentences.zh: 最终我还是说服了他们俩跟我一起离开，尽管他们内心深处有一部分人想留下来，尽管那混乱与黑暗，

sentences.en: at least for a moment, made more sense to them than anything any adult could tell them.
sentences.zh: 至少在那一刻，对他们来说比任何成年人说的话都更有意义。

sentences.en: Why should they listen to us?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要听我们的？

sentences.en: Look at what we let happen.
sentences.zh: 看看我们都放任了些什么发生。

sentences.en: A week or so later, I would watch them come home from another teen-led protest, this time to the mayor's house to demand the removal of police from public schools.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，我看着他们从另一场青少年主导的抗议活动中回家，这次是去市长家，要求将警察从公立学校撤出。

sentences.en: They would come home positively giddy, bursting with pride, energy, power, and a sense of hope that, in my own life, I don't ever remember feeling.
sentences.zh: 他们回家时显得格外兴奋，充满了自豪、活力、力量，以及一种我在自己的人生中从未感受过的希望感。

sentences.en: But that first night, as I tried to fall asleep, the image that stayed with me was my son's 17-year-old frame, indistinguishable to the police
sentences.zh: 但在那个第一晚，当我试图入睡时，脑海中挥之不去的画面是我儿子17岁的身影，在警察

sentences.en: and security cameras from any Black man's, from anyone's baby, silhouetted against the light from
sentences.zh: 和监控摄像头眼中，他与任何黑人男性、任何人的孩子都毫无区别，他映衬在

sentences.en: a police flashbomb, the terror and glee in his eyes as he saw it finally acknowledged that everything is on fire.
sentences.zh: 警察闪光弹的光亮中，当他看到一切终于被承认正在燃烧时，他眼中流露出的恐惧与狂喜。

sentences.en: I didn't take them to that proteSt. I didn't want them to be at that proteSt. It's just that I had no choice but to meet them there.
sentences.zh: 我没有带他们去那场抗议。我不想让他们去那场抗议。只是我别无选择，只能去那里接他们。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 这段内容由Autumn录制。

sentences.en: Autumn is an app you can download to listen to lots of audio stories from publishers such as the New York Times.
sentences.zh: Autumn是一款你可以下载的应用程序，用于收听来自《纽约时报》等出版商的大量音频故事。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
